headline: Jury throws out Musk's suit against OpenAI; power concentration rises
body: The day's main story came from a courtroom in Oakland. A federal jury rejected all of Elon Musk's claims against OpenAI, Sam Altman and Microsoft as time-barred, clearing the way for OpenAI's IPO and for-profit structure. Separately, Anthropic bought Stainless, a startup that builds SDKs for other AI companies. Both stories push up Power Concentration: more of the AI stack sits with a few big players. That helps Enslaved God (a powerful AI held by one owner) and Benevolent Dictator, and hurts Libertarian Utopia, which needs power to stay spread out. A small counterweight came from Cursor shipping a cheaper coding model built on China's open-weight Kimi K2.5. Horizon Balance fell 0.33 to 1.6.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia -0.6 and Enslaved God +0.6, mostly from the Musk verdict (-0.48/+0.48) with the Stainless deal adding -0.18/+0.18; Benevolent Dictator +0.5 from the same two stories.
